headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens To Miss Week 5
summary: The sprained ankle Lamar Jackson suffered in Week 4 will sideline the superstar quarterback for at least one game. The Ravens will not create any mystery about the two-time MVP’s status, ruling him out for their Week 5 matchup against the Falcons. headline: Joe Alt, Derwin James among Chargers ruled out for Sunday
summary: The Chargers won't have either of their starting offensive tackles for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
summary: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headline: Broncos rule out Pat Surtain II, Riley Moss
summary: The Broncos ruled out both of their starting cornerbacks for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

headline: Rams DT Aaron Donald practices in full, plans to play MNF
summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald practiced in full Friday and said he plans to play Monday night against the Bills after missing Week 4 with back soreness.

headline: Chiefs, Vikings are first pair of non-playoff teams since 2013 to start 4-0
summary: The NFL has only three 4-0 teams after four weeks.
